steps.text: 分析 可用类似于例20的方法，将分子拆分，再分项积分；也可作万能代换化为有理函数的积分；最简单的方法是做凑微分.

方法1

$$
\begin{array}{r l} \text {原式} & = \int \frac {\frac {1}{2} (1 + \sin x + \cos x) + \frac {1}{2} (\sin x - \cos x) + \frac {1}{2}}{1 + \sin x + \cos x} d x \\ & = \frac {1}{2} \int d x - \frac {1}{2} \int \frac {\cos x - \sin x}{1 + \sin x + \cos x} d x + \frac {1}{2} \int \frac {1}{1 + \sin x + \cos x} d x \\ & = \frac {1}{2} x - \frac {1}{2} \int \frac {d (1 + \sin x + \cos x)}{1 + \sin x + \cos x} + \frac {1}{2} \int \frac {1}{2 \sin \frac {x}{2} \cos \frac {x}{2} + 2 \cos^ {2} \frac {x}{2}} d x \\ & = \frac {1}{2} x - \frac {1}{2} \ln | 1 + \sin x + \cos x | + \frac {1}{2} \int \frac {1}{\tan \frac {x}{2} + 1} d \tan \frac {x}{2} \\ & = \frac {1}{2} x - \frac {1}{2} \ln | 1 + \sin x + \cos x | + \frac {1}{2} \ln | \tan \frac {x}{2} + 1 | + C. \end{array}
$$

方法2 令 $u = \tan \frac{x}{2}$ ，则 $x = 2\arctan u$ ， $\mathrm{d}x = \frac{2}{1 + u^2}\mathrm{d}u$ ， $\sin x = \frac{2u}{1 + u^2}$ ， $\cos x = \frac{1 - u^2}{1 + u^2}$ .

$$
\begin{array}{r l} \text {原式} & = \int \frac {1 + \frac {2 u}{1 + u ^ {2}}}{1 + \frac {2 u}{1 + u ^ {2}} + \frac {1 - u ^ {2}}{1 + u ^ {2}}} \cdot \frac {2}{1 + u ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} u = \int \frac {u + 1}{1 + u ^ {2}} \mathrm{d} u \\ & = \arctan u + \frac {1}{2} \ln (1 + u ^ {2}) + C = \frac {x}{2} + \ln \left| \sec \frac {x}{2} \right| + C. \end{array}
$$

方法3

$$
\begin{array}{r l} \text {原式} & = \int \frac {\left(\sin \frac {x}{2} + \cos \frac {x}{2}\right) ^ {2}}{2 \sin \frac {x}{2} \cos \frac {x}{2} + 2 \cos^ {2} \frac {x}{2}} \mathrm{d} x = \frac {1}{2} \int \frac {\left(1 + \tan \frac {x}{2}\right) ^ {2}}{1 + \tan \frac {x}{2}} \mathrm{d} x \\ & = \frac {1}{2} \int \left(1 + \tan \frac {x}{2}\right) \mathrm{d} x = \frac {x}{2} + \ln \left| \sec \frac {x}{2} \right| + C. \end{array}
$$

meta.chapter: 第3章 一元函数积分学
meta.commentary:
评注 三角函数有理式的积分 $\int R(\sin x, \cos x) \mathrm{d}x$ ，作万能代换 $u = \tan \frac{x}{2}$ ，可化为有理函数积分：

$$
\int R (\sin x, \cos x) d x = \int R \left(\frac {2 u}{1 + u ^ {2}}, \frac {1 - u ^ {2}}{1 + u ^ {2}}\right) \frac {2}{1 + u ^ {2}} d u.
$$

这种方法一定可行，但未必简单.
